predictions.G6_0: M 的每个保留域：基算子在训练句式的 dev 上复核单向 R_2N ≥ 0.95；C：基算子 RRR-16 在 confirm6 上单向 R_2N ≥ 0.95；K：name3 上 Tok-U 的 R_6 ≥ 0.95。不通过即停止排查。
predictions.M1: 基算子的单向 plus R_2N，每个（骨干，域）。H-general：≥ 0.90；H-template：≤ 0.50。
predictions.M3: F{1}：单向 plus R_2N ≤ 0.20，交替 R_2N ≥ 0.80，且 A(1) − A(⌊N/2⌋) ≥ 0.50。H-general：全部可评格子成立。
predictions.M4: 状态监督类（基算子、手术、槽位 C3-U4）的潜空间预测。H-general：逐 world 一致率 ≥ 0.85，且相对朴素判断的提升 CI 下界 > 0；类别准确率 ≥ 0.80。H-template：一致率 < 0.75。
predictions.M5: D 探测：CE 格子 D ≥ 0.5 且 R_2N ≤ 0.20；状态监督格子 D ≤ 0.20。H-general：≥ 90% 的格子成立。
predictions.Q18prime: M1、M3、M4 都成立为 H-general；M1 在至少 2/3 个 BART 域上符合 H-template，则为 H-template；其他为混合。若预检后 M3 没有可评格子，按 M1 与 M4 判定，并在报告中注明。
predictions.CT1: 未收敛 C3 系格子：槽位+上下文预测器的类别准确率，以及逐 world 一致率相对只看槽位的提升。H-context：类别 ≥ 0.80，且提升的 CI 下界 > 0；H-slot：提升的 CI 含 0。
predictions.CT2: 非劣检验集：槽位+上下文 − 只看槽位的逐 world 一致率。H-context：下降 ≤ 0.01，且 CI 下界 > −0.02。
predictions.Q19: CT1 与 CT2 都成立为 H-context。
predictions.K1: OR-U4 的单向 R_30（bind3，seed 中位数）。H-representable：≥ 0.90；H-unrepresentable：≤ 0.50。
predictions.K2: max(Att2L-U4, Att2L-U8) 的单向 R_30。H-closure：≥ 0.90；H-horizon：Att2L-U4 的 R_8 ≤ 0.50，且 Att2L-U8 的 R_12 ≤ 0.50。
predictions.K3: Att1-U8：R_8 与 R_12。H-horizon：R_8 ≥ 0.70 且 R_12 ≤ 0.50；H-closure：R_30 ≥ 0.90。
predictions.K4: name3、bind3fix 上各编辑器的 R_30。≥ 0.95（稳定性）；对立 ≤ 0.50。

operational.cells: M / C cell = (backbone, domain, operator or editor, path in {plus, minus, alt}); paths start at the world start; 2N steps. K: plus 30, minus 12, alt 12. Categories: composable >= 0.90, fail <= 0.20, otherwise partial (observed R_2N and predicted R-hat_2N alike). R_k = fraction of worlds whose decoded output is a success (multi-template: exact match after whitespace normalisation) at every step 1..k. All CIs: world cluster bootstrap, 2000 reps, seed 3101 (paired where a difference is taken).
operational.latent_prediction: v5 A.1 with the locked readout: per world, predicted chain success iff the argmax equals the gold state at every step t <= 2N; cell R-hat_2N = fraction of worlds predicted successful. The predictions are the locked simulation files (results/simulate_<bb>.json.gz); the argmaxes recorded during the post-lock chains are a consistency check only (must equal the locked simulation). Naive prediction: decoded success at step 1.
operational.M_rule: Domains = gates.M_domains (GM). M1 per (backbone, domain): base (F_empty) plus R_2N; verdict H-general iff all >= 0.90, H-template iff >= 2/3 of the BART M domains <= 0.50, else neither. M2 per (backbone, domain): seed medians of C1 R_1, R_2 (plus) and D (plus path; A.2 of v5: among worlds whose step-1 decode is parsable, fraction whose step-1 latent readout differs from the decoded state); H-general iff every domain meets R_1 >= 0.90, R_2 <= 0.20, D >= 0.8; H-template iff every domain has R_1 <= 0.50; a seed that could not learn counts as R = 0 without D. M3 per (backbone, domain) that passed the locked pre-check: F{1} plus R_2N <= 0.20, alt R_2N >= 0.80 and A(1) - A(floor(N/2)) >= 0.50 (A from the plus chain, fraction of worlds correct at step t pooled by folded displacement); holds iff every evaluable cell holds; none evaluable -> not evaluable. M4 per backbone, pooled over its state-family M cells (base, every F_S, slot C3-U4): per-world agreement (predicted vs observed chain success) >= 0.85 with the latent - naive CI lower > 0, and category accuracy >= 0.80 -> holds; agreement < 0.75 -> H-template side; M4 holds iff it holds on every backbone. M5 over the M editor cells (C1: CE; slot C3-U4: state; one-way plus and minus): fraction of cells meeting their D rule >= 0.90. Q18prime: H-general iff M1 H-general, M3 holds (or not evaluable, noted) and M4 holds; H-template iff M1 H-template; else mixed. If GM removed every domain, Q18prime = not evaluable.
operational.C_rule: Sets fixed at the lock (cells6.c_registry + train_new_bart_C.json convergence): CT1 = v1 C3, v3 C3-l3 / C3-l10, v4 P2b (month), v1 C3 (weekday, data definition verified by the audit) and every new C3n<u> whose dev L2 > 1.2 x RRR-16 dev L2; CT2 = base surgery (F_empty, F{1}, F_not1, F{j}), RRR-r / FF-r (r = N-4..N-2), v3 C3-rrrinit, v4 P2a, P2c, C3-U4, v5 C3n1200 / C3n2400, and every new C3n<u> meeting the rule. Readouts: slot = locked vote model full lams; ctx = slot + context (appendix A.3, lam_ctx from calib_ctx). Per-world agreement pooled over (world, cell) records of the set. CT1 holds iff ctx category accuracy >= 0.80 and the paired CI of (ctx - slot) agreement has lower bound > 0; H-slot side iff that CI contains 0. CT2 holds iff (ctx - slot) agreement >= -0.01 and its CI lower bound > -0.02. Q19: H-context iff CT1 and CT2 hold; H-slot iff the CT1 CI contains 0; else mixed. lam_ctx = the exact ML estimate on the dev context-substitution probes (calib_ctx_bart.json; lib6.fit_lam_ctx: grid incl. 0, ties to the smallest); a boundary estimate lam_ctx = 0 makes the ctx readout identical to the slot readout, so CT1 is then decided by construction (reported as such).
operational.C_exploratory: Declared before the lock, not part of any verdict: context drift = min_y d_ctx(h_t, y) per world and step (locked simulation files, key ctx_drift). On the CT1 cells, among worlds whose slot readout predicts chain success, the AUC of the maximal drift over steps 1..2N for predicting observed chain failure (and the same on CT2); plus, per CT1 cell, the first step at which the slot readout and the decode disagree.
operational.K_rule: Seed medians over 42/43/44 of plus R_k on bind3 (a seed that could not learn counts as R = 0). K1: OR-U4 R_30 >= 0.90 H-representable, <= 0.50 H-unrepresentable, else mixed. K2: H-closure iff max(Att2L-U4, Att2L-U8) R_30 >= 0.90; H-horizon iff Att2L-U4 R_8 <= 0.50 and Att2L-U8 R_12 <= 0.50; else mixed. K3: H-horizon iff Att1-U8 R_8 >= 0.70 and R_12 <= 0.50; H-closure iff Att1-U8 R_30 >= 0.90; else mixed. K4: per new editor kind and domain in {name3, bind3fix} (OR-U4 only bind3fix) the seed-median R_30; stable iff all >= 0.95, unstable iff all <= 0.50, else mixed. Q17prime is reported as the (K1, K2, K3) triple with the reading of PLAN B7.
operational.oracle: OR-U4 (oracle routing) is a diagnostic, never a usable editor (PLAN B1 new rule 3).
